IBM Bee Catcher

How to play

Tap the bee

Tap or click before it flies away. Missing costs 10 points and resets your streak.

⚡

Build a streak

Every 3 catches raises your multiplier up to 5×. A miss resets it.

🚀

10 levels

Clear each level to advance. Every level-up adds +6s to the clock.

🌟

Golden bees

Worth triple points and add +3s to the clock. Catch them fast!

🚫

Avoid decoys

Dark bees with a red ring. Tapping one costs 100 points.

🏆

Win swag

Your final score sets your tier and your IBM prize.
